description.en: Stops the player at an invisible boundary: three child threads run together. The player character turns toward _pos (20 frames), walks to it (30 frames) and stands; the camera moves over 40 frames to the RPG camera position offset by _pos, looking at _pos raised by 3.5; and the message _txt_id is shown. Then the player is warped in place (CMND_CHR_WARP_SET), camera control ends and the normal field camera is restored (SetExitRpgCamera).
Point to walk back to [x, y, z].

examples.case: From a map event (real usage, from ev43040000.nut)
